# qwed-verification

> Open-source AI verification infrastructure for deterministic verification of LLM outputs, tool calls, code, schemas, and agent state before production execution.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/QWED-AI/qwed-verification): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://docs.qwedai.tech): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
